City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018 received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition regarding community benefits for Rexdale, submitted by Councillor Joe Mihevc, Ward 21, St. Paul's, containing the names of approximately 145 persons. 2. Petition regarding community benefits for Rexdale, submitted by Councillor Ana Bailão, Ward 18, Davenport, containing the names of approximately 657 persons.
